title: Sourced update v1
description: A retrieved source item: source identity, title, canonical URL, publication time and retrieval time. Status is sourced. This is not an investment conclusion. Identity for a repeat fetch is source_id plus content_hash. There is no user id.

source_id.description: User-independent source identity from the rights register.

published_at.description: Publication time stated by the source. Null when the source does not state one.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical sourced item.

correction_of.description: Earlier update_id this row corrects. Null when this row is not a correction.
